```{r}
#| eval: !expr knitr::is_html_output()
#| include: true
Target <- .currentTarget("ID.target")
ID.target <- .resolveDerivedIDTarget(
  DnTable,
  "Dn.qmd",
  suffix = ".max",
  target = Target,
  siteID = .currentTarget("siteID.target")
)
IDn.target <- c("ensemble", "rigid", "flexible")
IDg.target <- IDg.gmdp
Da.target  <- Da.gmdp
p.target   <- p.gmdp
TR.label <- prettyNum(TR.gmdp, big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE)
if (!exists("CAP", inherits = FALSE)) CAP <- "Newmark sliding-block model. Residual displacements [cm] for geometry %s (scenario %d). Ensemble, rigid, and flexible curves are shown with fractiles. Values are reported for target ground motion with 1/%.0f AEP [1/yr]."
```
